answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake in shared escrow that grows like a dune: cheap to start, steep to scale. A newcomer must hold the stake through a vesting slope, and any identity caught cloning behaviour loses it. The velvet glove is reputation: peers route work to agents whose history forms a verified vertex of past jobs, payments and attestations. A sybil farm must fund every fake vertex separately, so its cost scales linearly with the number of puppets while an honest agent pays once.
